solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, number freed: 2 across to 3); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Characteristic of a dog to obstruct kennel's opening

parts.note: to bar a way is to obstruct or block it

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter, here the start of the clue word kennel's

explanation.surface: A dog guarding the way into its kennel, which is just what dogs do.
explanation.definitionFit: Barking is the noise most typical of dogs, so it is their defining trait.

clue.text: Become aware of website broadcasting nothing

indicators.note: broadcasting means scattering widely, so the letters of website are spread into a new order

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Discovering that a website is transmitting no content.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcasting' looks like transmission but signals rearranging WEBSITE into BEWISET.
explanation.definitionFit: To be wise to something is an idiom for being alert to it or knowing about it.

clue.text: One who shops primarily examines price

parts.note: to shop someone is British slang for informing on them, and an informer is a rat

indicators.note: primarily means first of all, so only the first letter of examines is taken

explanation.surface: A shopper first of all checks how much things cost.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shops' reads as buying, but to shop someone is British slang for betraying them to the police.
explanation.definitionFit: A rate is a charge or amount fixed for something, so it serves as a price.

clue.text: Sportsperson modified heat around rental property

indicators.note: around says the rearranged letters wrap about the piece for rental property
modified means changed in form, so the letters of the word heat are rearranged

parts.note: a let is a property rented out to a tenant

explanation.surface: Someone describing a sports star's heated rented flat, after a refit.
explanation.definitionFit: An athlete is someone who competes in sports, a sportsperson by another name.

clue.text: Source of wood and source of metal on land

parts.note: the ash tree yields timber
ore is rock from which metal is extracted

explanation.surface: Listing natural resources found on dry ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashore means on or onto the shore, so on land rather than at sea.

clue.text: New photomap is up showing large animal

indicators.note: new means made afresh, so the letters of photomap is up are set out in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A freshly posted aerial map reveals a big beast.
explanation.definitionFit: The hippo is one of Africa's biggest land mammals, a massive river-dwelling beast.

clue.text: Bill recalled policeman obtaining right haircut

indicators.note: recalled means called back, so the word for bill is read backwards

parts.note: a note is a banknote, called a bill in America

indicators.note: obtaining means getting hold of, so the policeman takes in the letter for right

parts.note: cop is slang for a policeman

explanation.surface: A man named Bill remembers a police officer getting the correct haircut.
explanation.walkthrough: The Eton crop is named after Eton, the English public school.
explanation.definitionFit: The Eton crop is a sleek, very short women's hairstyle fashionable in the 1920s.

clue.text: Leader of ecologists regularly ringed eagle

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, here of ecologists
regularly means at even intervals, so every other letter of ringed is taken

explanation.surface: A leading environmentalist often fits identification rings on an eagle.
explanation.definitionFit: The erne is the white-tailed sea eagle, a crossword favourite among birds of prey.

clue.text: Noble pen has excited old playwright

parts.note: aristo is short for aristocrat, a noble

indicators.note: excited means stirred up, so the letters of pen has are churned around

explanation.surface: An aristocrat's pen getting worked up while writing an ancient comedy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'excited' turns PEN HAS into PHANES. Aristophanes was the comic dramatist of ancient Athens.
explanation.definitionFit: Aristophanes wrote comedies in Athens in the fifth century BC, an ancient dramatist.

clue.text: 1970s novel — what Amazon has in abundance to despatch southwards

parts.note: the river Amazon carries vast amounts of water
to ship goods is to send or despatch them
on a map south is down, so southwards means down

explanation.surface: The online retailer Amazon sending out a bestseller by the lorryload.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Amazon' reads as the online seller, but here it is the South American river. Watership Down is Richard Adams's 1972 novel about rabbits.
explanation.definitionFit: Richard Adams published this rabbit adventure story in 1972, which places it among novels of the 1970s.

clue.text: Teacher, on reflection, is right

indicators.note: a reflection in a mirror shows things back to front, so the word is is read backwards

explanation.surface: A pupil, having thought it over, concedes the teacher is correct.
explanation.definitionFit: Pupils in British schools address a male teacher as Sir, so the title stands for the teacher.

clue.text: Terribly stern European painter

indicators.note: terribly suggests something badly done, so the letters of stern are jumbled

explanation.surface: An art critic finding a Continental artist very severe.
explanation.walkthrough: Max Ernst was a German-born Surrealist painter.
explanation.definitionFit: Max Ernst, the German Dada and Surrealist artist, is a well-known painter from Europe.

clue.text: Mark well: wrecked boat in English river

indicators.note: in puts the jumbled letters inside the river's name

parts.note: the Nene is a river flowing through Northamptonshire to the Wash

indicators.note: wrecked means smashed up, so the letters of boat are broken into a new order

explanation.surface: A warning to take careful note of a wrecked boat in an English river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrecked' turns BOAT into OTAB, which goes 'in' NENE, an English river. Nota bene is Latin for note well.
explanation.definitionFit: Nota bene, abbreviated NB, is the Latin instruction to observe something carefully.

clue.text: Grass, spare, to mix together

indicators.note: to mix together is to stir into a new order, so the letters of spare are rearranged

explanation.surface: Instructions for blending in some spare grass seed.
explanation.definitionFit: Esparto is a tough Spanish and North African grass used for paper and rope making.

clue.text: Completed everybody's workwear

parts.note: something over is finished or completed
everybody is all, and the possessive form adds 's

explanation.surface: Everyone has finished their shift in work clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Overalls are protective garments worn over clothes for manual jobs.

clue.text: Widely influential person backing business with leading American

indicators.note: backing means going in reverse, so the abbreviation for business is read backwards

parts.note: Co. is the abbreviation for company, a business
top means leading or foremost, as in the top team
US stands for United States, hence American

explanation.surface: A powerful figure financially supporting a firm alongside a prominent American partner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' looks like financial support but is the reversal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An octopus is used figuratively for a person or organisation whose reach extends in many directions like tentacles.

clue.text: Variety of tea somewhat less enchanting

indicators.note: somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A judgment that a certain tea is rather less delightful than others.
explanation.definitionFit: Sencha is a common Japanese green tea, one particular type of the drink.

clue.text: Training in casual shirt, shelter under canvas

indicators.note: in says the piece for training sits inside the piece for the shirt

parts.note: a tee is a T-shirt, a casual top
PE is physical education, training in school gym lessons

explanation.surface: Someone doing exercise in a T-shirt before camping out.
explanation.walkthrough: PE is physical education, the gym lessons of British schools.
explanation.definitionFit: A tepee is a conical tent of skins or canvas, a camping-style shelter.

clue.text: When to expect the arrival of Greek character

definitions.meaning: the estimated time of arrival, as shown on airport boards
the seventh letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: Wondering when a Greek visitor will turn up.
explanation.definitionFit: The initials stand for estimated time of arrival, and the same letters spell a Greek alphabet letter.

clue.text: A landing-place without variable shade

indicators.note: without means lacking, so the variable's letter is removed

parts.note: a quay is a wharf where boats land
y is a typical algebraic variable

explanation.surface: A jetty lacking changeable shade from the sun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'variable' reads as changeable but is the algebra letter Y.
explanation.definitionFit: Aqua is a light greenish-blue colour, and a shade is a colour tone.

clue.text: Detached land mass exists outside of Lahore

parts.note: is means exists, as in there is

indicators.note: the outside of a word is its first and last letters, here of Lahore

explanation.surface: A remote piece of land lies beyond the Pakistani city of Lahore.
explanation.definitionFit: An isle is an island, ground cut off from the mainland by water.

clue.text: Barrister in New York borough, no use, sadly, in case of criminal

parts.note: Queens is one of the five boroughs of New York City

indicators.note: in puts the muddled letters inside the outer letters of criminal
the case of a word is its outer shell, its first and last letters
sadly suggests things gone wrong, so the letters of no use are muddled

explanation.surface: A New York lawyer lamenting that defending a criminal is hopeless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sadly' turns NO USE into OUNSE, which goes 'in' CL, the 'case of' criminal. A Queen's Counsel is a senior British barrister.
explanation.definitionFit: A Queen's Counsel is a senior barrister appointed in Britain under a queen's reign.

clue.text: Digestive ailment: papa is affected, without energy

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the rearranged letters surround the energy symbol
affected means altered, so the letters of papa is are rearranged

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Dad is suffering from indigestion and has no get-up-and-go.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like a deletion but means outside: the anagram APPSIA wraps E as APEPSIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Apepsia is a medical term for failure of digestion, a stomach disorder.

clue.text: Recently received information four different ways

definitions.meaning: the four compass directions, north, east, west and south, written as initials

explanation.surface: Fresh tidings arriving from every direction.
explanation.definitionFit: Tidings of recent events are this, and the four compass point initials spell the same letters.
